product.title: Art of Balboa Park Walking Tour

description.text: Discover Balboa Park with a local guide on a walking tour focused on architecture, public art, and hidden design details across one of San Diego's landmark cultural districts.

highlights: Guided walking route through Balboa Park's signature plazas and gardens.
Learn the stories behind landmark buildings, public art, and design motifs.
Small-group format for a relaxed pace and easy Q&A with your guide.

start.description: Plaza de Panama, 1549 El Prado, San Diego, CA 92101

itineraryItems.title: Plaza de Panama
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide and get an overview of Balboa Park's layout and history.

itineraryItems.title: El Prado
itineraryItems.description: Walk the main promenade to view Spanish Colonial Revival architecture and courtyards.

itineraryItems.title: Botanical Building Area
itineraryItems.description: Pause for photos and context about landscape design and restoration efforts.

additionalInfo: Operates in most weather conditions; please dress appropriately.
Public transportation options are available nearby.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start?
faqs.answer: The tour meets at Plaza de Panama, 1549 El Prado, San Diego, CA 92101.
